title: Copying one input symbol
statement: Let $E$ and $G$ be finite Turing machines over the Boolean alphabet, let $e_e,e_x$ be states of $E$ and $g_e,g_x$ states of $G$, and suppose that $E$ has at least one work tape. For any Boolean word $x$ and any position $i<|x|$, one step of the emission-loop machine from its copy configuration for the prefix of $x$ of length $i$ yields its copy configuration for the prefix of length $i+1$.
hypotheses_covered: E and G are finite Turing machines over Bool

g_e and g_x are states of G
